description: Cross-check of independently summed remaining weekly forecasts against ESPN current-season period0/split0 appliedTotal, excluding already-played NE/CHI Week7. This comparison is diagnostic, not an assumption that seasonal and matchup-specific forecasts must agree.
interpretation: 580 rows agree to rounding. All32 DST seasonal appliedTotal values differ from the independently league-rescored weekly sum; preserve the weekly sum, not an unsupported seasonal relabel. Two explicit-zero weekly players have no period0/split0 total. Preseason split2 and prior-season records were not used.
